open_questions.q: When matching drift entries have different before-and-after values, should they still be grouped?
open_questions.assumed: Yes; group by resource type and attribute path, show one representative value transition, matching the issue's proposed grouped entry.

open_questions.q: Does 'relevant' include Terraform no-op resource_changes entries?
open_questions.assumed: No; it means a resource with a displayable planned change, matching the report's existing change filtering.
